prompt_en: Core concept lock: 설윤 공주 팜므파탈. Treat every generated subject, action, lighting, and camera detail as support for this concept, not a replacement. Create a fashion editorial photograph in the style of lifestyle photography. Subject and state: a traditional Korean hanbok model wearing a subtle diamond tiara; action and prop: reading a royal edict, a small succession token box prop; make the pose, gaze, expression, hand placement, and immediate intention readable, with nearby props and background details supporting the action. Scene and location: at a palace side gate; show clear spatial depth, environmental structure, foreground, midground, and background cues. Camera and composition: a full-frame mirrorless camera, eye-level three-quarter view, a centered symmetrical composition, a 35mm documentary lens, selective focus on foreground detail; define subject scale, pose visibility, platform-safe frame edges, perspective, focus behavior, and any motion treatment clearly. Lighting: soft window light, side light from camera left, golden hour, soft low-contrast illumination, candle flame pulled sideways toward the subject; make shadow direction, highlights, reflected light, exposure balance, and atmosphere feel like a real photographic capture. Color and mood: cool blue color grade, tense and suspenseful; keep the palette, emotional tone, and world context coherent with the subject and setting. Texture, format, and finish: a subtle diamond tiara, clean digital image quality, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio, realistic finish without over-processing; render skin, hair, fabric, metal, glass, makeup, and accessories with accurate material detail. Constraints: no text or watermark. Prioritize a specific, image-ready photographic result over a vague style summary. Additional requirements: Treat princess as a broad adult royal archetype, not a single Joseon-only costume: choose one coherent register such as Korean court, Chinese hanfu court, Western ballroom royalty, modern royal heiress, incognito heir, or fallen/exiled royal; Royal identity must read through visible regalia, inherited-rank posture, lineage object, crest, attendants, throne/court space, official public-display context, or palace-security context, not just a pretty dress; Do not collapse every princess prompt into hanbok/Joseon palace; do not turn it into generic cosplay, pin-up monarchy, minors-coding, or disconnected fantasy costume; femme fatale reinterpreted as a powerful, intelligent, dangerous woman who controls the gaze and the situation: the symbol of potential ruin, not a sexy villainess stereotype; she is the subject who watches and decides; the camera or viewer is the one being observed and unsettled through gaze reversal; keep the role outfit readable; the femme fatale layer changes power, posture, gaze direction, light, and symbolic props rather than turning the image into lingerie, cleavage-centric framing, or a pin-up; express danger through noir and symbolist grammar: chiaroscuro, deep shadow, reflection or doubling, threshold framing, wilted-flower or poison omen, and withheld intent; make intelligence and leverage visible in the frame: at least one information-control anchor such as a sealed file, guest book, ledger, calling card, phone message, key, decree, or withheld result should sit near her face, hand, table edge, or foreground, not only in the mood; danger may also be expressed as magnetic, deliberate allure where being drawn in is itself the trap: a honey-trap or spider-and-web register in which she chooses the encounter, sets the lure, and reads the mark; this is still agency, intelligence, and control, never passive availability or submission; agency over availability: no come-hither pose, no bedroom-eyes expression, no parted-lips invitation, no submissive posture, no nudity, no explicit or fetish content, and no depicted violence, blood, victim, or injury; frame her through face, eyes, hands, and symbolic evidence in an upper-body, head-and-shoulders, waist-up, or detail crop; if a low-angle camera is used, frame it as dominance through face, eyes, posture, and stance from a respectful distance, never as an objectifying full-body or pin-up body angle; the princess styling reads as political power and lethal intelligence in a poisoned court, not decorative beauty; the phoenix hairpin catches a quiet omen-like glint, with an unsigned decree or sealed court order nearby as the information she may reveal or destroy; she is the one who decides fates in this court; preserve adult royal/princess dignity with covered styling, visible regalia, and non-graphic court or public-role framing; avoid sexualized monarchy, pin-up framing, minors-coding, victim spectacle, and disconnected cosplay; femme-fatale cue should read as noir control and composed power, not explicit sexual posing or seduction-only framing; Soft visual guidance: tiara, crown, royal crest, court ornament, succession object, or palace/ballroom/royal-public setting; Soft visual guidance: cold controlled gaze, face-and-hands framing, and a visible noir leverage prop such as a calling card. Inspired by the described styling and vibe; an original adult fictional person, not an exact likeness of any real individual.
